name: Force of Will
oracle_text:
You may pay 1 life and exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Counter target spell.
blocked_sentences: You may pay 1 life and exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.

needs.what: a cost key that exiles a card from the payer's hand chosen by a selector (here: a blue card other than this spell), usable inside a card-level `alternative_cost` alongside `pay_life`, so the whole 'pitch' alternative cost of Force of Will / Force of Negation / Misdirection / the Modern Horizons elementals can be paid
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cost_keys` carries `discard_selector`, which picks a hand card by the same kind of filter but puts it in the graveyard, not exile -- a visible rules difference (graveyard recursion, delirium, threshold, Tarmogoyf) that makes it an approximation rather than the printed cost. The only exile costs are `exile_self` (the source itself, and the source here is the spell being cast) and `exile_from_graveyard` (wrong zone). `alternative_cost` itself already works and already accepts `pay_life` and a `condition`; the single missing piece is the exile-a-card-from-hand payment.
